notes: Printer Bot 3.3.0-beta.4 is a prerelease. It adds a size for the print queue: Advanced, All platforms, Print queue size, from 0 MB to 100 GB (1 GB by default), with a slider and a box. Give it more room for a long stream such as a subathon. 0 MB turns the print queue off: new receipts go straight to the printers, as before 3.3.0, and the receipts that wait already still print. And a test print that was not sent because receipts waited for its printer no longer says "Last print failed" once they have printed. From 2.5.0 on, this version needs no new import. After the update, restart Streamer.bot once, as the dock asks: it runs two copies of the action's code, and the update reaches only one of them until it starts again.
